purpose: Four painted transparent 4x4 articulated-bird parts atlases

passes.prompt:
Convert the specified characters from the provided approved concept sheet into a PRODUCTION 2D CUTOUT ANIMATION PARTS ATLAS. Preserve their exact charming light hand-drawn watercolor/pencil textures, muted cream/sage/teal colors, round pudding proportions, tiny black bead eyes and tiny beaks. This is a genuinely TRANSPARENT PNG with alpha, NOT a poster. No paper background, no ground shadows, no text, labels, gridlines, captions, props or checkerboard painted into the image. The reference sheet is for faithful character identities, not for copying its background/layout.

Strict invisible grid: square image with EXACTLY FOUR equal-height ROWS and FOUR equal-width COLUMNS (16 equal square cells). Leave transparent empty gutters around every part; all artwork stays within its own cell. Every piece is CENTERED inside its cell; no overlaps between cells. A body should fill about 72% of its cell. Separated parts should be fully painted shapes ready to rotate at joints. Each row corresponds to one species; across that row:
COLUMN 1: complete bird BODY including the head, face, beak and short tail, but REMOVE both wings and REMOVE all feet/legs; clean painted fill where wings were, no amputated stumps or outline gaps.
COLUMN 2: its detached NEAR WING, a rounded feather/mitten shape pointing DOWN in a relaxed folded pose, attachment root at TOP, fully separated from body.
COLUMN 3: its detached FAR WING, same species palette, similarly pointing DOWN, root at TOP.
COLUMN 4: its detached TWO LITTLE FEET with short legs, isolated as a pair, soles on common baseline. Feet and wings not attached to a second body.
Bird bodies face gently RIGHT in three-quarter view with TWO bead eyes visible. Keep all pixels outside the actual art genuinely transparent. Enough detail for a ~70px game character, crisp clean silhouette; NOT oil-paint, not vector icon, not glossy 3D.
Rows TOP TO BOTTOM: row1 PIGEON (gray bread-shaped pigeon with thick neck, soft gray/lavender collar, pink feet); row2 CROW (soft charcoal ball, small cream eye patches with black pupils, tiny blunt beak, charcoal feet); row3 COCKATIEL (pale cream bird, peach cheek marks, upright three-feather crest, gray-beige wings, pink feet); row4 DOUGH BIRD (soft cream inflated dough ball with three simple top folds, tiny eyes and beak, tiny warm-beige feet, soft doughy wings). Only these four species. Do not draw their seeds, pebbles, sparkles or ground. All four columns must be clearly detached parts, especially NO wings remain baked onto the body.

Preserve clearly crescent silhouette.

cleanup_prompt: Remove background paper haze and colored fringe outside every part; retain handdrawn opaque interiors; preserve genuine alpha; no layout changes.
